# Code of Conduct

We are committed to a welcoming, technically rigorous and harassment-free
community. Be respectful, critique ideas and code rather than people, assume
good faith, and make room for contributors with different backgrounds and
experience levels.

Unacceptable behavior includes harassment, discrimination, threats, sustained
disruption, publication of private information, or sexualized conduct.

Report conduct concerns privately to the repository maintainers. Maintainers
may edit or remove content, restrict participation, or ban participants when
necessary to protect the community. Enforcement decisions should be fair,
documented and proportionate.
